nodes.label: chess-game-node
nodes.description: Entry point: parses CLI flags, loads config, initializes game state, handles user moves, displays board. Handles graceful shutdown via SIGTERM/SIGINT. Imports: 0, settings, board-repo, move-handler. Exports: command-line interface with history and controls.

nodes.label: board-repo-node
nodes.description: Data access: SQLite-based game board. Implements double-buffered rendering of chessboard squares with move history tracking and piece persistence.

nodes.label: renderer-node
nodes.description: Visual architecture design: generates the CLI prompt or a game board from the core application components. Renders moves, checksmate scenarios, and displays history.

nodes.label: controller-node
nodes.description: Business logic layer: executes legal moves according to chess rules. Maintains game state variables such as selected squares and current move history. Checks for valid moves and captures responses.

nodes.label: settings-node
nodes.description: Configuration layer: reads from settings to define game rules and preferences. Manages theme selection (classic/modern), move history retention, and sound toggling.

nodes.label: move-hisotory-node
nodes.description: Moves history implementation: keeps track of all chess moves in the game. Maintains a chronological log that can be exported to various formats like PGN.

nodes.label: style-sheet-node
nodes.description: UI style layer: applies custom theme options. Handles color schemes and typography preferences for the visuals.

nodes.label: move-handler-node
nodes.description: Moves logic: checks moves' validity and updates chess positions accordingly. Handles castling, en passant, king's move limitations.

nodes.label: greeting-node
nodes.description: Greeting layer: displays welcome messages and initial game controls.

nodes.label: exit-node
nodes.description: Exits layer: handles shutting down the chess game application gracefully.

nodes.label: tests-node
nodes.description: Test suite: implements helper functions to validate game states and perform unit testing of core components.

nodes.label: build-node
nodes.description: Build process: compiles all source code into the final executable.

nodes.label: core-posh-types
nodes.description: Types layer: defines core types and enforces type checking across the application to maintain consistency and reliability.

nodes.label: user-interface-repo
nodes.description: UI component repository: provides access to utility functions and configurations used across the application interface.

nodes.label: data storage repository
nodes.description: Data access: SQLite-based database for storing game position history and moves.

nodes.label: handlers.go
nodes.description: API request handlers. Routes incoming requests to business logic, validates input, formats JSON responses. Handles HTTP methods (GET, POST, PUT, DELETE). Imports: service, types.
